verdictRationale: PARTIAL retained at 4f0fd2cd9b. The owner decision AMD-AUD-RIGHTS-001 is complete and keeps named external standards OFF. Exact-current source inspection supersedes two of the three gaps this record previously held open: draft-pack reads ARE now author/platform-admin scoped (packs.routes.ts:59/:116, packService.ts:259) and the legacy ISO 27001 preset IS hard-disabled at compile time with two independent choke points (auditIso27001LegacyPresetGate.ts:35, auditPresets.ts:207, AuditsHub.tsx:796). The third gap survives in substance: the independence detector now has a real caller (auditIndependenceDetectorJob.ts:67) registered in the scheduler (Scheduler.ts:891) but fenced default-OFF (Scheduler.ts:38), so it is implemented, not operationalized — and operationalizing it is a deployment act, not a repository state. The recorded 10/10 denominator is preserved as an accurate historical fact at productSha 78a618942e but is not exact-current: the same file now holds 23 cases and was not re-run in this pass (real-PostgreSQL suite; no Docker and no runtime window were taken). See exactCurrentReconciliation20260818 for the literal evidence and supersededVerdictRationale20260817 for the superseded wording.
